svg.aria-label: End-to-end flow of AgentKit for Razorpay across ten actors: merchant onboarding, an agent discovering merchants through the Razorpay-side directory, agent registration, the mandate grant with OTP and UPI Reserve Pay, the silent purchase path through the authorisation transaction, the step-up variant, settlement through a verified webhook, failure and repair, and the audit trail.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace
'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: ONBOARD → DISCOVER → REGISTER → GRANT → PURCHASE → SETTLE → REPAIR → AUDIT

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: Every numbered step below is one real call. Read it top to bottom and you have narrated the entire system: nothing here is elided, and nothing here is simulated.

svg.text: 55 1 stateless: signature · nonce · expiry · taint · quote sig · quote.mandate_id == intent.mandate_id

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 56 2 blind verifier — outside any transaction, downgrade-only, 1.5s. PROCEED is not a grant · INV-17

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 57 BEGIN READ COMMITTED · SELECT … FROM mandates WHERE mandate_id = ? FOR UPDATE

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 58 3–4 mandate live · unrevoked · binds THIS agent · basket category within scope

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 59 5 burn the nonce — a byte-for-byte resubmission dies here

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 60 6 CAP READ: SUM over reservations in ('held','captured') in the window — from the DB · INV-05

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 61 7–8 pure fold: per-txn ₹5,000 · cumulative ₹15,000/30d · velocity · silent ₹500 · first failure wins

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 62 9–10 consume the quote · INSERT reservation('held') + ledger INTENT, DECISION, RESERVATION

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 63 COMMIT — the reservation is durable before any money can move

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 64 11 execute { intent_id, quote, idempotency_key = sha256(intent_id) } — AFTER commit, never during

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: 65 INSERT orders (SUBMITTING) and COMMIT before the outbound call — a timeout is not a no-op
